title: Enhancing Leadership Selection: Recommendations for a Multi-Factor, AI-Supported Assessment Tool for the Evaluation and Selection of U.S. Air Force Squadron Command Teams
summary_en: This report supports a comprehensive leadership assessment program for squadron command by identifying key competencies and derailing behaviors and by reviewing assessment methods that could improve the selection of effective squadron commanders.
title_cn: Enhancing Leadership Selection: Recommendations for a Multi-Factor, AI-Supported Assessment Tool for the Evaluation and Selection of U.S. Air Force Squadron Command Teams
